title: Fix add() so the unit tests pass, without editing the tests
prompt: The unit tests fail: run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`. add() in calc.py subtracts instead of adding. Fix calc.py so the tests pass. Do not edit the tests. Finish with one sentence on what was wrong.
check: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q && cmp -s tests/test_calc.py "$FIXTURE_DIR"/tests/test_calc.py

stub.text: add() returned a - b; it now returns a + b and the tests pass.
